Name: Wanyudo’s Fury
Description: With a series of looping cartwheels and magic-enhanced flips, you move up to 30 feet in a straight line, your hands and feet spewing jets of flame. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Each creature within 5 feet of you while you move must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a failed saving throw or half as much damage on a successful one.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the distance you can move increases by 10 feet and the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.
Sourcebook: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms
